summary: LanzaTech Global, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 2,000,000 shares of common stock at $10.00 per share, totaling $20 million. The placement agent is D. Boral Capital LLC, receiving a 6.5% fee. This is a routine equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No change of control, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring is involved. Investors should monitor share dilution and market reception of the offering, but no event-driven special situation trigger is present.
